title: Total silence only found in constant chatter of falling rain answers glean in puddles atop unfurling leaves hiding the spring's truth #poemsofpresence
summary: Total silence only found in constant chatter of falling rain answers glean in puddles atop unfurling leaves hiding the spring's truth #poemsofpresence #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Total silence
only found in
constant chatter
of falling rain
answers glean
in puddles atop
unfurling leaves
hiding the spring's
truth
#poemsofpresence
#smallpoems
